quarterly_data.quarter: Samsung press release: Samsung and Mistral AI Announce Strategic Partnership for (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supplier Mistral: Samsung entered a strategic partnership with Mistral AI under which it will integrate Mistral's AI services and solutions, including the Mistral Large model, across its semiconductor operations to build customized on-premises AI models; Samsung aims to apply targeted AI models to fab defect detection and equipment optimization to accelerate development cycles, manufacturing precision and yield stabilization across its advanced memory and logic chips. Samsung also led Mistral AI's Series D funding round, taking a strategic equity stake (amount not disclosed).
